payment.title: Paying the Revenue Department
payment.needPermission: Paying tax needs the bank reconciliation permission
payment.reverseDesc: Reverses the payment journal and puts the statement line back to unmatched.
payment.pickLine: Pick the statement line that paid this tax
payment.noLines: No outgoing statement line can pay this tax
payment.extraHalf: Fill both the account and the amount of the extra row, or leave both empty
payment.extraTitle: Other items in the same amount (optional)
payment.extraHint: A bank fee, or the surcharge / penalty on the Revenue Department receipt, booked as expense to the account you pick.
payment.failed: Could not pay the tax. Try again.

tie.pnd1Gl: Tax withheld (all employees) {left} baht against ledger 2153 PIT payable posted by this month's payroll runs {right} baht
tie.pnd1Other: Other movement on ledger 2153 this month, not from payroll runs, {left} baht (normally {right} baht)
tie.ssoGl: Contributions (employee + employer) {left} baht against ledger 2160 SSO payable posted by this month's payroll runs {right} baht
tie.ssoOther: Other movement on ledger 2160 this month, not from payroll runs, {left} baht (normally {right} baht)
tie.pnd1aMonths: Tax for the year on the return {left} baht against the opening balance + the filed monthly PND.1 returns {right} baht
tie.citGl: Corporate income tax computed on the return {left} baht against the income tax booked {right} baht (book the tax with a journal voucher before closing the year)
tie.pndGl: Tax withheld (all payees) {left} baht against the withholding tax payable account of this form {right} baht
tie.pp36Gl: VAT to remit {left} baht against ledger 2152 VAT payable {right} baht
tie.outputGl: Output VAT (box 5) {left} baht against ledger 2151 {right} baht
tie.inputGl: Input VAT (box 7) {left} baht against ledger 1170 {right} baht
tie.outputRegister: Output VAT (box 5) {left} baht against the output register total {right} baht
tie.inputRegister: Input VAT (box 7) {left} baht against the input register total {right} baht

reg.claimedBase: Purchases with the right to claim

cert.title: Withholding tax certificates of the employees, year {year}
cert.lead: Built from the rows confirmed in the PND.1 Kor of the year, one for every employee. Two copies each (one for the employee to attach, one to keep).
cert.empty: No PND.1 Kor is confirmed for this year
cert.emptyBody: Confirm the PND.1 Kor of the year first; then the employees' certificates can be issued.
cert.name: Employee

periodClose.title: Period and year close
periodClose.lead: Close the months in order from the first open one. A closed month reopens one at a time, latest first, with a reason. Once all 12 months are closed the year can be closed.

checklist.label: Checklist before closing {month}
checklist.title: Checklist before closing {month}
checklist.frozen: Warnings accepted at close (kept as they were)
checklist.noneAccepted: No warning was open when it closed
checklist.acknowledge: I have seen the {n} warnings above and want to close this month
checklist.exitsAbove: The exits are the "Go fix" links above
checklist.notNext: Months close in order: close the first open month first

reopen.monthBody: Only the latest closed month reopens. The reopen is kept in the history and the audit log with its reason.
reopen.yearBody: The year-end closing entry is reversed on the last day of the year and the year's revenue and expense balances come back exactly; then months reopen one at a time, latest first.

periodClose.yearReady: All 12 months are closed. Closing the year sweeps revenue and expense into the income summary (3300), then the net into retained earnings (3200), dated the last day.
periodClose.yearNotReady: The year cannot close yet: all 12 months must be closed and the year over.
periodClose.netProfit: Net profit of the year {amount} baht moved to retained earnings (3200)
periodClose.netLoss: Net loss of the year {amount} baht moved to retained earnings (3200)

schedules.notFoundBody: This schedule is not in the selected company, or it was removed.

recurring.title: Make {doc} recurring
recurring.body: A copy of this document is kept as the template. Each run makes a draft dated the next run date (nothing is issued for you; you check and issue it).

amortise.title: Amortise {doc}
amortise.body: Spreads the amount of a line posted to the prepaid expense account over monthly runs. The amount, months, accounts and the plan you see are frozen from now on.

detail.templateHint: A copy frozen when the schedule was made; it does not follow the original document.
detail.reverseHint: If a month was posted wrongly, reverse the latest run's voucher (on its Ledger tab) and run that month again.
detail.stopBodyAmort: Nothing more will be amortised. The remaining {amount} stays on account {account}. A stopped schedule cannot be restarted. The stop is audited.
detail.stopBodyRecurring: No more drafts will be made. The stop is audited.
detail.frozenHint: The amount, months, accounts and plan are frozen from creation. Only the name can change.
detail.templateDoc: Edit template: copy again from document no.
detail.templateDocHint: Number of a {type} document (empty = keep the template)

settlement.vatNote: The output-VAT treatment of deposits awaits the SP-R ruling (no output VAT is posted from a deposit yet)
settlement.notFoundBody: It is not in the selected company, or it was removed

kinds.apply_deposit: Apply an advance received to an invoice
kinds.apply_prepayment: Apply an advance paid to a bill

form.pickParty: Pick a party first to see the documents that can be used
form.tolerance: Company tolerance: rounding up to {rounding}, write-off and bank fee up to {writeOff}
form.nettingHint: Netting takes the same amount from the receivable and the payable side, with no difference

deposits.title: Deposits and advances
deposits.emptyBody: When money is received or paid beyond the documents, the rest shows here and can be applied later

list.title: Netting and settlements
list.intro: Where an advance was applied, receivables were netted against payables or a small difference was written off. Money still waiting is at
list.searchPlaceholder: Search by number, document or party
list.emptyBody: Create one to apply an advance to an invoice, net receivables against payables or write off a small difference

detail.reverseBody: A reversing journal is posted and the outstanding amounts and advances of every document in it are restored. This cannot be repeated.

bank.noStatements: A cash box has no statement lines

reconcile.postedFinal: Posted and final (reverse the journal to undo)
reconcile.lockedReason: This line is inside the locked reconciliation period, so a reason is required. It is recorded on the line and on the documents.

lock.title: Lock the reconciliation up to a date
lock.hint: Allowed once every line up to that date is matched, posted or skipped. Afterwards cancelling a match needs bank.reconcile and a reason.

match.title: Find a match
match.suggestions: Suggestions: same amount, within 7 days, same account
match.noSuggestion: No suggestion. Search by document number or party.
match.share: Amount matched to this line (when a document is split over several lines)
match.feeHint: The bank took a fee out of this amount; the fee is booked at the line's date
match.roundingHint: Use a minus sign when the bank shows less than the document
match.noDiffHint: The selected documents must add up to the line amount

post.title: Book a statement line
post.controlHint: Control accounts are not offered (tax, receivable / payable, deposits and prepayments, payroll, cash / bank, equity): documents post them, or use "Transfer between accounts" for money moving between the company's own accounts
post.final: Once posted it cannot be edited; reverse the journal if it is wrong

transfer.reverseDesc: Reverses this transfer's journal (both lines must be unmatched first). A reason is required and recorded.
transfer.title: Transfer between the company's accounts
transfer.hint: Booked once: debit the receiving account, credit the paying one, and this line is matched. The other account's line is offered the same journal when an equal amount shows on its statement

import.title: Import statement
import.file: Statement file (CSV from K BIZ or PDF from K PLUS)
import.passwordHint: Used to open this file only; the password is never stored

lines.title: Statement lines
lines.empty: No statement lines yet — import a statement

pay.title: Pay payroll {run}
pay.body: The whole run is paid. The amount is the net total the system stored when the run was issued; a partial payment is not possible. If it is wrong, unpay and pay again.
pay.amount: Amount (net pay of the whole run)
pay.dateHint: Not before the run date ({date}), in an open accounting period
pay.noAccounts: There is no active bank or cash account

unpay.title: Unpay payroll {run}
unpay.body: The payment is reversed in the books and the run goes back to “Issued”. The payslips do not change. Not possible while the payment is matched to a bank statement line (unmatch it first).

drawer.title: Payslip of {name}
drawer.description: Period {period} · every figure is from the slip stored when the run was issued
drawer.note: The s.50 bis certificate is issued once a year (PND.1 Kor)

company.title: Company profile
company.lead: The details used on documents, tax returns and payroll. Each section saves on its own and is recorded in the audit log.

identity.title: Registered details
identity.description: Name, tax ID, branch and address as on the company certificate
identity.vatNote: VAT status is changed in the tax settings
identity.confirmBody: Documents already issued and returns already filed keep the name, address and tax ID they were issued with (the snapshot taken when they were issued). New documents use the new details.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: Trade name, phone, email and website shown on documents

payroll.title: Payroll and social security
payroll.description: The 10-digit social security employer account, used on the SSO 1-10 return

fiscal.title: Fiscal year
fiscal.description: The month the fiscal year starts. Only the calendar year (starting in January) is supported for now.
fiscal.locked: Cannot be changed because a period is closed
fiscal.lockedExit: Ask the administrator to reopen the periods first

images.title: Images
images.description: The company logo and stamp (documents will use them once enabled in the document template settings)

notes.title: Default notes per document type
notes.description: A new document of each type starts with this note. Issued documents do not change.

image.hint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 1 MB
image.hintSvg: PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG, up to 1 MB
image.type: Only PNG, JPEG or WebP files are accepted
image.typeSvg: Only PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG files are accepted
image.size: The file is larger than 1 MB

users.title: Users and permissions
users.lead: The members of this company and their roles. Every change is recorded in the audit log.

actions.resetLink: Issue a password reset link for {name}

link.once: Shown once only. Copy it to the user now; after you close this it cannot be shown again (you can issue a new one).
link.title: Link for {name}

users.deactivateBody: The user can no longer sign in to this company. Their history is kept. You can activate them again.

roles.title: Roles and permissions
roles.lead: The three system roles cannot be edited. Copy one as a new role and adjust the permissions to the duties of each person.
roles.readOnlyNote: A system role cannot be edited
roles.deleteBody: This cannot be undone. A role can be deleted only while no user holds it.
roles.sod: Caution: this role can both create and approve documents of type {types}, and the company has approval switched on for them. It can still be saved; this is only a warning (approving your own documents is a company setting).

permissions.bank_read: Read bank accounts and statement lines
permissions.bank_manage: Manage bank accounts and import statements
permissions.ledger_schedule_manage: Manage recurring documents and amortisation schedules
permissions.ledger_period_close: Close accounting periods and the fiscal year
permissions.ledger_period_reopen: Reopen accounting periods and the fiscal year
permissions.report_arap_read: Read receivables, payables and sales / purchase summaries
permissions.tax_read: View tax filings and VAT registers
